features.description: The staged Grok security batch preserves its protections while bootstrap platform administration, new-chat persistence, quiz attempts, cancellation, and browser-user isolation work through their real entry points.
steps: Exercise platform and tenant admin guards, new-chat create races, quiz start/submit, embedding cancellation, restore cancellation, terminal stream handling, scoped browser storage, and OAuth callback redirects.
Observe typed statuses, owner checks, released concurrency slots, terminal first-wins behavior, and zero current regression failures.

features.description: Every provider boundary rejects malformed tool exchanges before HTTP and slow SSE consumers apply bounded backpressure without breaking cancellation or telemetry.
steps: Run Responses, Anthropic, and Chat Completions pairing failures plus slow-client and disconnect probes.
Observe zero outbound HTTP for invalid exchanges, producer-ahead at most one, and exactly-once resource release.

features.description: Gateway, Assistant, and Knowledge hot paths remove confirmed serial round trips and event-loop blocking while preserving authorization and state semantics.
steps: Run rate-policy, read-only tool batch, MCP reuse, memory I/O, retrieval, embedding, pool, and worker-role benchmarks.
Observe the declared RTT, parallel wall-clock, cache, deadline, event-loop, and isolation gates without correctness regressions.

features.description: The console and SDKs meet bundle/stream contracts and AI Platform improves the three recorded complex-task failure modes without benchmark-specific routing.
steps: Exercise cold routes, 200-message restore, long streaming, four SDK envelopes, and the finance, engineering, and research eval cases.
Observe bundle and long-task budgets plus semantically grounded structured outputs and real tool receipts.

features.description: The current repository source is running in the owned Docker stack and passes static, container, in-app-browser, TTFT, cancellation, and three-cohort quality gates.
steps: Hot-update the owned Compose stack, validate health, run browser journeys, control/canary TTFT, and three complete eight-task cohorts.
Observe healthy services, no provider 400, resumable stopped sessions, the latency gate, and per-cohort quality acceptance.
